title: Extract gateway_helpers.go from gateway.go
description:
## What
Create `core/controlplane/gateway/gateway_helpers.go` by moving helper functions, validation constants, request types, and error types OUT of `gateway.go`.

## Exact items to move (by function/type name)

### Constants & Vars (move these const/var blocks)
- `maxJobPayloadBytes` through `maxLabelValueLen` (lines 63-70 in current file)
- `validTopicRegex` var (line 80)
- Timestamp constants block: `microsPerSecond`, `microsPerMillisecond`, `secondsThreshold`, `millisThreshold`, `microsThreshold` (lines 92-98)

### Request Types (move these structs)
- `submitJobRequest` struct (lines 262-290)
- `policyMetaRequest` struct (lines 292-302)
- `policyCheckRequest` struct (lines 304-320)

### Methods on submitJobRequest
- `(r *submitJobRequest).applyDefaults` (lines 322-341)
- `(r *submitJobRequest).validate` (lines 343-395)

### Builder Functions
- `buildJobMetadata` (lines 397-423)
- `buildPolicyCheckRequest` (lines 425-472)

### Parsing & Normalization
- `normalizeAPIKey` (lines 2561-2569)
- `parsePriority` (lines 2765-2776)
- `parseBool` (lines 2778-2785)
- `idempotencyKeyFromRequest` (lines 2787-2803)
- `tenantFromRequest` (lines 2805-2821)
- `parseActorType` (lines 3014-3023)
- `appendUniqueTag` (lines 3025-3036)
- `parseContextMode` (lines 3038-3048)
- `deriveMemoryIDFromReq` (lines 3090-3095)
- `normalizeTimestampMicrosLower` (lines 3097-3111)
- `normalizeTimestampMicrosUpper` (lines 3113-3127)
- `normalizeTimestampSecondsUpper` (lines 3129-3143)
- `parseLockMode` (lines 3943-3950)
- `parseRetention` (lines 3952-3961)
- `lookupIntPath` (lines 2983-3012)

### Artifact Limit Functions
- `artifactMaxBytes` (lines 2823-2830)
- `artifactRequestedMaxBytes` (lines 2832-2847)
- `artifactMaxBytesLimit` (lines 2849-2855)

### Server Methods (enforcement)
- `(s *server).maxConcurrentRuns` (lines 2924-2939)
- `(s *server).enforceJobBackpressure` (lines 2950-2981)
- `(s *server).enforceMemoryID` (lines 3059-3088)

### Error Types
- `jobBackpressureError` struct + Error() method (lines 2941-2948)
- `memoryPolicyError` struct + Error() method (lines 3050-3057)

## How
1. Create new file `gateway_helpers.go` with `package gateway`
2. Add necessary imports (determine from usage — mainly `context`, `fmt`, `net/http`, `os`, `regexp`, `strconv`, `strings`, `time`, `unicode/utf8`, plus project imports like `configsvc`, `config`, `capsdk`, `env`, `pb`)
3. Move all listed items into the new file
4. Remove them from `gateway.go`
5. Run `go build ./cmd/cordum-api-gateway` — must compile

## Notes
- Do NOT move `defaultArtifactMaxBytes` or `envArtifactMaxBytes` — those are used by core (RunWithAuth)
- Do NOT move `defaultRateLimitRPS`, `defaultRateLimitBurst`, `defaultMaxHeaderBytes` — those belong in core
- Do NOT move `wsAPIKeyProtocol`, `shutdownTimeout`, `wsWriteTimeout` — those go to stream file
- The line numbers are from the CURRENT state of gateway.go (before any other splits)
definitionOfDone: gateway_helpers.go exists with package gateway header
All listed functions/types/consts/vars moved from gateway.go
gateway.go no longer contains any of the moved items

implementationPlan.description:
Create `gateway_helpers.go` with package header, imports, and helper constants.

1. Create file `core/controlplane/gateway/gateway_helpers.go`
2. Add `package gateway`
3. Add imports block (determine exact set from usage — expect: `context`, `fmt`, `net/http`, `os`, `regexp`, `strconv`, `strings`, `time`, `unicode/utf8`, and project imports: `cordum-io/cordum/core/infra/config`, `cordum-io/cordum/core/configsvc`, `cordum-io/cordum/core/infra/bus/capsdk`, `cordum-io/cordum/core/infra/env`, `cordum-io/cordum/core/protocol/pb`)
4. Add helper constants extracted from the mixed const block at lines 63-70:
```go
const (
	maxJobPayloadBytes = 1 << 20
	maxPromptChars     = 100_000
	maxLabelKeyLen     = 63
	maxLabelValueLen   = 256
)
```
5. Add timestamp constants from lines 92-98:
```go
const (
	microsPerSecond      = 1_000_000
	microsPerMillisecond = 1_000
	secondsThreshold     = 1e12
	millisThreshold      = 1e15
	microsThreshold      = 1e18
)
```
6. Add `var validTopicRegex` from line 80

**DO NOT move**: `defaultGrpcAddr`, `defaultHttpAddr`, `defaultMetricsAddr`, `defaultArtifactMaxBytes`, `defaultRateLimitRPS`, `defaultRateLimitBurst`, `defaultMaxHeaderBytes`, `wsAPIKeyProtocol`, `shutdownTimeout`, `wsWriteTimeout`, or any env* constants — those stay in gateway.go.

Move request types and their methods into gateway_helpers.go.

Cut from gateway.go and paste into gateway_helpers.go:

- `policyMetaRequest` struct (lines 292-302)

These are contiguous lines 262-472 in gateway.go — move the entire block.

Move scattered parser/normalization functions into gateway_helpers.go.

These are mostly contiguous from lines 2765-2855 plus `normalizeAPIKey` at 2561-2569.

Move enforcement methods, error types, and remaining helpers into gateway_helpers.go.

Cut from gateway.go and paste into gateway_helpers.go:
- `(s *server).maxConcurrentRuns` (lines 2924-2939)

- `normalizeTimestampMicrosUpper` (lines 3113-3127)

These are contiguous lines 2924-3143.

Also move from later in the file:
- `parseLockMode` (lines 3943-3950)
- `parseRetention` (lines 3952-3961)

Remove the moved constants from gateway.go's mixed const block.

The const block at lines 59-75 currently contains both core and helper constants in one block. After moving helper constants to gateway_helpers.go:
1. Remove `maxJobPayloadBytes` (line 63), `maxPromptChars` (line 65), `maxLabelKeyLen` (line 69), `maxLabelValueLen` (line 70) from the block
2. Remove `validTopicRegex` var (line 80)
3. Remove timestamp constants block (lines 92-98)
4. Keep all remaining constants in the block intact

Also clean up the import block in gateway.go — remove any imports that are no longer needed after moving all the helpers out. Check each import: if it was only used by moved code, remove it.

Verify build compiles successfully.

Run: `go build ./cmd/cordum-api-gateway`

If build fails:
- Check for missing imports in gateway_helpers.go (add any that were missed)
- Check for duplicate symbols (ensure items were removed from gateway.go after copying)
- Check for import cycles (shouldn't happen — same package)
- Fix and re-run until build passes

Do NOT modify any test files.
